passages.text: Our class makes a sound map of the streets near the school library. At the gate, the teacher asks us to turn right into a quieter lane. Each group gets a piece of paper to mark places where different sounds can be heard. We record footsteps, birds and a shop bell, but do not write down private conversations. Back inside, we compare the maps and notice that the same corner sounds different at different times. The project helps us listen closely to familiar places and respect the people who use them.

parallelText.en: Our class makes a sound map of the streets near the school library.
parallelText.zh: 我们班给学校图书馆附近的街道制作声音地图。

parallelText.en: At the gate, the teacher asks us to turn right into a quieter lane.
parallelText.zh: 到门口时，老师请我们右转进入一条较安静的小巷。

parallelText.en: Each group gets a piece of paper to mark places where different sounds can be heard.
parallelText.zh: 每组拿到一张纸，标记能听见不同声音的位置。

parallelText.en: We record footsteps, birds and a shop bell, but do not write down private conversations.
parallelText.zh: 我们记录脚步、鸟鸣和商店铃声，但不记私人谈话。

parallelText.en: Back inside, we compare the maps and notice that the same corner sounds different at different times.
parallelText.zh: 回到室内，我们比较地图，发现同一个转角在不同时刻声音不同。

parallelText.en: The project helps us listen closely to familiar places and respect the people who use them.
parallelText.zh: 这个项目帮助我们细听熟悉的地点，也尊重使用这些地方的人。

passages.text: Our school starts a repair table for pupils who want to fix simple items rather than throw them away. Mia brings a pair of gloves with one small hole near the thumb. There is a lot of useful cloth in the donation box, so she chooses a matching patch. An adult helper shows her how to hold the material safely before she begins. Ben draws the steps on a card so the next visitor can follow the same process. By the end of lunch, the gloves are useful again and our table has its first instruction card.

parallelText.en: Our school starts a repair table for pupils who want to fix simple items rather than throw them away.
parallelText.zh: 学校设立维修桌，让想修理简单物品的学生不用把它们扔掉。

parallelText.en: Mia brings a pair of gloves with one small hole near the thumb.
parallelText.zh: 米娅带来一副手套，其中一只拇指旁有小洞。

parallelText.en: There is a lot of useful cloth in the donation box, so she chooses a matching patch.
parallelText.zh: 捐赠箱里有许多实用布料，于是她选了一块相配的补丁。

parallelText.en: An adult helper shows her how to hold the material safely before she begins.
parallelText.zh: 成年助手在她动手前演示怎样安全握住材料。

parallelText.en: Ben draws the steps on a card so the next visitor can follow the same process.
parallelText.zh: 本把步骤画在卡片上，供下一位访客照着做。

parallelText.en: By the end of lunch, the gloves are useful again and our table has its first instruction card.
parallelText.zh: 午休结束时，手套又能用了，维修桌也有了第一张说明卡。
